integrity: Analytical exchange/counting proof plus reproducible independent finite-domain verifier; no claim of formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Three committee seats; finite candidate set of at least three; nonempty binary approval ballots with at most two candidates each. The main conclusion is a population-wise uniform guarantee, not a profile-wise equivalence. Finite testing is supplementary; independent validation is unperformed.
title: A sharp quota-arithmetic threshold for welfare-maximal justified representation under two approvals
